blockingIssues.description: `Renumbering` disables `HMMER` pair validation by passing `validate_pairs=False`, then only revalidates when the requested chains differ from the full default set `['H', 'K', 'L', 'A', 'B', 'G', 'D']`. An explicit full-chain request therefore still silently drops unsupported pairs: `Renumbering(allowed_species=['alpaca'], allowed_chain=['H', 'K', 'L', 'A', 'B', 'G', 'D'], run_multiproc=False)` succeeded during scrutiny and loaded only `('alpaca', 'H')` instead of raising for the missing `alpaca K/L/A/B/G/D` pairs.
